title: Simon 6.2.30–6.2.32 and 6.3.10: the cone over a compactly supported integer multiplicity cycle is an integer multiplicity filling
statement: Let n, P ∈ ℕ and let S ∈ 𝒟_{n+1}(ℝ^P) (a GeometricCurrentOn univ (n + 1) on ℝ^P = Euclid P) be an integer multiplicity current (IsIntegerMultiplicity S: S = τ(M, θ, ξ) for an IMRep in ℝ^P) with spt S compact and ∂S = 0 (S.boundary = 0). Then there is an integer multiplicity R ∈ 𝒟_{n+2}(ℝ^P) with spt R compact and ∂R = S (R.boundary = S). (R is Simon's cone 0 ⨯ S = h_#([[(0,1)]] × S), h(t, x) = tx.)
lean_statement: ∀ (n P : ℕ) (S : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (n + 1)), IsIntegerMultiplicity S → IsCompact S.support → S.boundary = 0 → ∃ R : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (n + 2), IsIntegerMultiplicity R ∧ IsCompact R.support ∧ R.boundary = S
